 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. STILLWATER — Oklahoma State quarterback Drew Mestemaker is listed as questionable on OSU's initial availability report Wednesday night for the Cowboys' road game against Arizona State .
 Mestemaker suffered a "stinger" right shoulder injury on the first drive of last Saturday's game against Texas Tech . He continued playing until OSU's starters were pulled in the fourth quarter.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Coach Eric Morris said Mestemaker was "gonna be OK."
 "Yeah, Drew's a tough kid and obviously was able to finish the game, and so we'll just continue to monitor how he feels," Morris said on Tuesday. "I mean, he's as tough as they come, and he's a competitor at heart and loves this team and loves to compete."
 Mestemaker leads the NCAA with 3,239 passing yards and 30 passing touchdowns.
 Tight end Carson Kolb, defensive tackle Landon Dean and receiver Dayvon Standard are listed as out for Saturday's road game against the Sun Devils.
 Linebacker Tate Romney and offensive lineman Desmond Magiya are listed as doubtful.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Tight end Morgan McPhaul is listed as questionable.
 Linebacker Ethan Wesloski is listed as probable.
